failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query generated after hop 1: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' This is a compound yes/no question bundling two separate targets, which the retriever cannot use well.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query after hop 1: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' Query after hop 2 (identical): 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' The queries are verbatim identical across hops 2 and 3.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 names the missing entity: 'Prince's Hall of Fame induction status (particularly the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, which would be the most relevant for a recording artist)' and 'Patty Jenkins' Hall of Fame induction status'. (ii) Query after hop 1 targets these entities: 'Has Prince been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? Has Patty Jenkins been inducted into any Hall of Fame?' Despite well-formed queries targeting the named gaps, no passages about Prince's or Patty Jenkins' Hall of Fame induction status were retrieved across all three hops.
